channel.title: Orielsy Diaz — Research & Writing
channel.description: Technical essays, architecture explorations, and systems design by Orielsy Diaz.

item.title: Where Does the Framework End and the Platform Begin?
item.description: A preliminary investigation into how Web Components, JavaScript Signals, native navigation, view transitions, DOM templating work, and Open UI may redistribute frontend responsibilities between the browser platform and frameworks.

item.title: From Prompts to Project Memory: Spec-Driven Development for Coding Agents
item.description: A repository-grounded look at using version-controlled specs, decisions, and project rules as durable memory for coding agents across long-running software work.

item.title: Architecture Notes: Audio Chunking, Transcription Filtering, and Real-Time Speech UI Systems
item.description: A technical exploration of streaming audio chunk management, Whisper transcription filtering, and high-performance Electron overlay rendering, grounded in the current public speechBubbles and whisper-api source.

item.title: Documentation-Driven Adaptive UX
item.description: Exploring how enterprise product knowledge can become contextual interface behavior through deterministic state, validation, authored guidance, and evidence-aware response policy.

item.title: AI as a UI Capability, Not Just a Chatbot
item.description: Rethinking generative AI as an ambient interface capability—powering structured extraction, semantic ranking, and inline adaptive transformations rather than conversational bubbles.
